import os
import openpyxl

input_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/110-2/1_110-2_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/110-2_0_e186154a/1_110-2_output.xlsx"

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb["Sheet1"]

filter_range = "A1:C13"

# Use the criteria represented by the example filtered output in columns G:I:
# Column 1 -> {1, 2}, Column 2 -> {11, 12}, Column 3 -> {101, 102}
criteria_rows = []
for r in range(2, 14):
    vals = [ws.cell(r, c).value for c in range(7, 10)]  # G:I
    if all(v is not None for v in vals):
        criteria_rows.append(vals)

if criteria_rows:
    criteria = [
        {str(row[0]) for row in criteria_rows},
        {str(row[1]) for row in criteria_rows},
        {str(row[2]) for row in criteria_rows},
    ]
else:
    criteria = [
        {"1", "2"},
        {"11", "12"},
        {"101", "102"},
    ]

# Apply AutoFilter over the allowed answer range.
ws.auto_filter.ref = filter_range
ws.auto_filter.filterColumn = []
for idx, crit in enumerate(criteria):
    ws.auto_filter.add_filter_column(idx, sorted(crit), blank=False)

# Simulate the AutoFilter result by hiding rows that do not meet ALL three criteria.
ws.row_dimensions[1].hidden = False
for r in range(2, 14):
    row_values = [ws.cell(r, c).value for c in range(1, 4)]
    keep_visible = all(str(row_values[i]) in criteria[i] for i in range(3))
    ws.row_dimensions[r].hidden = not keep_visible

os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
